
## Install

1. Download `MacCursor-X.Y.Z.zip` below and open it.
2. Move **MacCursor** to `Applications` (or `~/Applications`, which lets updates install without an admin password).
3. Open it. macOS says **"MacCursor.app" Not Opened** because MacCursor is free and isn't notarized by Apple (that needs a paid developer account). Click **Done**, not **Move to Trash**.
4. Go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**, then confirm. You only do this once; updates install without it.

Requires macOS 26 or later. Already installed? MacCursor updates itself.
